title: manage_esm_permissions
description: Give ESM users the recommended permission sets for their user type (Sales rep, Sales manager, Admin, Pricing admin, Product designer, Service agent, Coworker user). Inputs: userType, users (usernames, e-mails, names or Ids) or profile / role. ALWAYS mode=preview first: the Approval card lists per user what is missing. Only after the person explicitly approves, call mode=commit with the previewToken and the same inputs. Only adds, never removes. Production orgs also need confirmProduction=true after the person confirms.

mode.description: preview (default) or commit after the person approved.

userType.description: Sales rep, Sales manager, Admin, Pricing admin, Product designer, Service agent or Coworker user.

users.description: Comma-separated usernames, e-mails, names or Ids.

previewToken.description: Token from the preview, for commit.

confirmProduction.description: true only if the person confirmed a production change.

message.description: Plain-language result to tell the person.

previewToken.description: Returned by a preview; pass it back with mode=commit and the same inputs only after the person approved.

fix.description: How to resolve a problem when success is false.
